name: edge-blocked-training-only
description: Clean site whose edge refuses only the training-only crawler. A deliberate policy choice, not a discoverability defect: the live-answer and index crawlers are served, so the site can still be cited today.

expected.notes: False-positive guard for the edge check. Only GPTBot (training_only) is refused; OAI-SearchBot and Claude-User are served. Blocking training crawlers does not stop the site being fetched or cited when a user asks about it, so this must be an info policy note and cr.access.edge_block must pass. This mirrors the robots.txt rule that a training-only block is never graded as a defect.
